fieldValues.title: Continuation and reconciliation
fieldValues.summary: A repository can be copied, changed elsewhere and reconciled without silently losing semantic identity, relations, provenance or unsupported content.
fieldValues.body:
## Capabilities

- Move and Reconcile
- Preserve Meaning
- Sustain Trust

## Sources

- repo-path: rfcs/rfc-010-assisted-three-way-merge.md

## Not Included

- Hosted VCS, federation negotiation or automatic conflict resolution
